title: Orqix workflow test suite, version 1 (CG-Q01, docs/build/S148)
description: One file format for the Studio Test tab (export and import), the shared publication suite and CI (orqix test run). Every case is a dry run of the workflow: nothing is started, called or stored. The server reads input, scenario, expect and assertions; studio holds the Test tab's editing state and is ignored by the server and by CI.

workflowKey.description: The workflow these cases test. When present, a run against another workflow is refused.

coverageMinimum.description: Least share (percent) of each item kind the cases must cover together. A missing kind has no minimum.

input.description: The request form answers, validated like a real request.

scenario.description: Step settings and mocks of the dry run (approvals, calls, workers, adapters, messages, children, ai), as SimulationScenario in contracts/openapi.yaml.

assertions.description: Further checks, as SimulationAssertions in contracts/openapi.yaml (outputs, path, rules, approvals).

studio.description: The Test tab's editing state of this case (answers as typed, step settings). Ignored by the server and by CI.
